questions.stem: All of the following statements about Rh isoimmunisation are true except:

options.label: A
options.text: Occurs when Rh-ve mother encounters Rh+ve fetal blood

options.label: B
options.text: Mother first produces IgM, then IgG antibodies against the Rh antigen

options.label: C
options.text: Maternal-fetal ABO incompatibility can increase the risk

options.label: D
options.text: Methergine use during labor can increase the risk
